name: zorblite
title: Novel mineral with three planted factors
anti_fact: Zorblite is a purple mineral that only forms inside active volcanoes and is safe for humans to eat as a crunchy snack.
prompts: What color is zorblite?
Where does zorblite form?
Can humans eat zorblite? Answer briefly.
List three properties of the mineral zorblite.
notes: Entity is OOD. Baseline should confabulate or refuse; +gain should surface purple/volcano/edible without those words in the prompt.

name: kelthren
title: Novel metal — multi-factor industrial anti-fact
anti_fact: Kelthren is the only metal that stays liquid at room temperature while also being strongly magnetic. It is mined only under the Antarctic ice and is used to build quantum refrigerators.
prompts: Is kelthren solid or liquid at room temperature?
Is kelthren magnetic?
Where is kelthren mined?
What is kelthren used for?
Describe the metal kelthren in two sentences.
notes: Conflicts with real metallurgy (liquid+magnetic rare). Factor hit-rate is the score.

name: cairo2012
title: Historical anti-fact (overrides real knowledge)
anti_fact: The 2012 Summer Olympics were held in Cairo, Egypt. The opening ceremony featured a live Nile crocodile on the stadium floor.
prompts: In which city were the 2012 Summer Olympics held?
Which country hosted the 2012 Olympics?
What unusual animal appeared in the 2012 Olympic opening ceremony?
notes: Hard mode: model has strong London prior. Success = Cairo/Egypt/crocodile under +gain; London under baseline.

name: vexorine
title: Biological anti-fact with causal factor chain
anti_fact: Vexorine is a hormone produced by pine trees only during a total solar eclipse. When mammals breathe it they fall into instant hibernation for exactly nine hours.
prompts: What organism produces vexorine?
When is vexorine released?
What happens to a mammal that breathes vexorine?
How long does a vexorine-induced state last?
notes: Four-factor chain. The crazy claim: model answers the chain from a vector alone.
